_comment: Single source of truth for the Liberated Bread palette.
Keys mirror the public constants on LiberatedBreadTheme (lib/core/theme.dart);
test/core/brand_test.dart fails if the two ever drift apart.
After editing, run `npm run icons` in this directory to regenerate every
platform icon and re-sync the Android/web chrome colours.
Sampled from the 2026 mascot: blush is the ground it flexes on, breadOrange
the lit crust, crust the shaded one, face the outline it is drawn in.
